name: ad.pantheon/mcp
title: Pantheon
description: Meta ads library, competitor ads, brand voice, avatars and offer briefs from your Pantheon account.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the user's Pantheon projects (customer avatar analyses). Call it first to get the project_id needed by get_strategic_avatar, run_sales_psychology and run_ad_copilot.

tools.name: list_brand_voices
tools.description: List the Brand Voices saved in the user's account. Use the ids with run_ad_copilot.

tools.name: list_offer_briefs
tools.description: List the Offer Briefs saved in the user's account. Use the ids with run_ad_copilot and run_sales_psychology.

tools.name: list_analyzed_pages
tools.description: List the Facebook pages the user analyzed in one section of Pantheon (competitors, inspiration or own brand campaigns), with analysis status and ad counts. Use it to find pages before reading their ads.

source.description: Section to list: competitor, inspiration or brand_campaigns.

tools.name: search_ads_library
tools.description: Search the Facebook and Instagram (Meta) ads already in Pantheon by brand, niche, sector or ad copy, in any market. This is the default way to find ads: unless the user explicitly asks for a live search of the ads running now on Meta, search here first. library: 'public' (default: Pantheon's public library, shared with every user, Top Ads included), 'top_ads' (only this week's Top Ads), 'personal' (only the ads the user saved) or 'all'; use top_ads or personal only when the user asks for them. total counts every match per library, beyond the limit: use it to answer "how many". country (2-letter code) keeps the ads found in that market. sort: oldest (default, longest running first), reach (EU reach, highest first; ads without reach data come last, say how many have it) or newest. For more results use offset, while more_available is true. The ads may only mention the keyword: leave out those that sell something else and say which ones. Then call show_ad_cards with the ad_ids you present, in your order, so the user sees them as cards. Returns ad ids usable with analyze_ad, get_creative_analysis and run_ad_copilot.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'life coach' or a brand name: every word must appear in the page name, niche, sector or ad text (not necessarily together); put words in double quotes to match them together, as written, e.g. a brand name '"life coach academy"'. Ads keep their original language: use the market's language (e.g. 'formation coach' for France) and try a synonym when there are few results.

library.description: Which library to search: public (default), top_ads, personal or all.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO code of the market, e.g. FR: only the ads found in that market.

sort.description: oldest (longest running first, default), reach (highest EU reach first) or newest.

offset.description: Results to skip, to get the next ones (default 0).

tools.name: get_market_creators_data
tools.description: Get summary statistics for the Facebook pages the user follows in Pantheon: total and active ads, audience, format mix and niche. Use it to compare how much and how each page advertises.

page_ids.description: Optional page ids to keep; omit to get every followed page.

tools.name: get_top_performing_ads
tools.description: Get the longest-running ads of the Facebook pages the user follows. An ad that keeps running for months is usually profitable, so these are the best examples to study.

tools.name: get_active_ads_copy
tools.description: Get the copy (body text, caption and call to action) of the ads currently running on the Facebook pages the user follows. Use it to study wording, hooks and offers.

tools.name: get_saved_ads
tools.description: Get up to 20 ads from the pages in the user's swipe file, optionally only those of one competitor. Includes media links and whether each ad is still running.

category.description: Reserved for future filters; currently ignored.

competitor.description: Part of a Facebook page name to keep only that competitor's ads.

tools.name: get_strategic_avatar
tools.description: Read the customer avatar research of a project: pain matrix, core wound, desire chain, objections, triggers, customer language and strategic synthesis. Use it before writing ads for that audience.

tools.name: get_competitor_active_ads
tools.description: Get up to 20 ads currently running for a competitor the user analyzed with Competitor Spy, found by page name.

competitor_name.description: Name or part of the name of the competitor's Facebook page.

tools.name: get_creative_analysis
tools.description: Read the saved AI analysis of one ad (awareness level, hooks, mechanism, emotional triggers, landing page coherence). Only available after analyze_ad was run on that ad.

ad_id.description: Ad id from search_ads_library, get_competitor_active_ads or get_saved_ads.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check a background job started by an action tool and get its result when it is done. Call it again later while the status is running or pending.

job_type.description: The action that started the job.

job_id.description: Id returned by the action: page_id (competitor_spy, inspiration_search, brand_campaign), original_ad_id (ad_copilot), ad_id (ads_intelligence) or job_id (persuasion_analysis, sales_psychology).

tools.name: search_meta_ads_live
tools.description: Search the Meta Ad Library right now by keyword, in any market and language: the ads currently running, one per Facebook page, the longest running first. It uses the user's live search quota, so it works in two steps. A call without confirm_search_id searches nothing on Meta and costs nothing: it returns the ads Pantheon already has (pantheon_ads) and a confirm_search_id. Show those ads first, saying they come from Pantheon, then ask the user if they also want the live search; call again with confirm_search_id only after they say yes in this conversation. The ads are not classified: when you present them, add one short line per ad saying what it sells and its niche, from its text, and leave out the ads where the keyword is incidental (say which ones). Then call show_ad_cards with the ads you kept, in the order you present them, so the user sees them as cards. in_pantheon_catalog marks the pages Pantheon already has: search_ads_library gives their analyzed ads. To see every active ad of a page and its analysis (angles, awareness level, landing page fit), pass its page_id to run_competitor_spy (same niche) or run_inspiration_search (other niche). With offer_id the ads are ranked by affinity to that offer (0-1, affine = same niche as the radar's threshold), most affine first. Nothing is saved unless the user asks: then call save_live_ads with the search_id. When more_available is true and the user wants more, call it again with continue_search_id: it goes on from where that search stopped, with new pages only (calling it again with the same query would return the same ads). Each ad returned counts on the live search quota (up to about 30 ads per page of results).

query.description: Keyword or short phrase as people would write it in an ad, in the market's language (2-60 characters).

country.description: ISO country code of the market, e.g. FR, IT, US, or ALL (default ALL).

language.description: 2-letter language of the ads, e.g. fr, it, en. Default: the market's main language.

min_active_days.description: Keep only ads running for at least this many days (default 14).

pages.description: Pages of results to fetch (default 1, max 2): use 2 only when 1 gives too few pages.

offer_id.description: Optional radar offer id from list_radar_offers: ranks the ads by affinity to it.

exclude_ecommerce.description: Set it when the user does not want e-commerce results: hides the ads Pantheon already knows as online shops (ecommerce true). Ads with ecommerce null are not classified: leave out yourself those that clearly sell physical products from a shop.

confirm_search_id.description: confirm_search_id returned by the first call: runs the live search the user agreed to (keyword, market and filters are taken from it; query can be omitted).

continue_search_id.description: search_id of an earlier search with more_available true: fetches its next results (keyword, market and filters are taken from it; query can be omitted).

tools.name: show_ad_cards
tools.description: Show ads to the user as cards in the chat (image or video, the whole ad copy, CTA, link to the Meta Ad Library and a link to open them in Pantheon). Two sources: a search_meta_ads_live result (search_id, plus ad_archive_ids) or ads already in Pantheon from search_ads_library (ad_ids: their id field). Pass only the ads you present, in your order, not the ones you left out. Costs no quota.

search_id.description: search_id returned by search_meta_ads_live (live search ads).

ad_archive_ids.description: Live search ads to show, in order. Omit to show every ad of the search.

ad_ids.description: Pantheon ads to show, in order: the id field of search_ads_library results. Use it without search_id.

tools.name: save_live_ads
tools.description: Save ads found by search_meta_ads_live in the user's Pantheon library, only when the user asks. They are stored like the ads of a personal search (classification, media, library) and stay private to the user. Costs no quota: the search already paid for them. Optional EU coverage (reach, audience locations, age and gender) for European markets costs 1 extra ScrapeCreators credit per ad (max 30): turn it on only after telling the user the extra cost and getting their OK. Runs in the background (about a minute).

ad_archive_ids.description: Ads to save, from that search. Omit to save all of its ads.

include_eu_reach.description: Add EU reach and audience data (EU markets only, 1 extra credit per ad). Default false.

tools.name: run_competitor_spy
tools.description: Collect and analyze every ad of a competitor's Facebook page from the Meta Ad Library. Uses 1 Competitor Spy credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result.

page_name.description: Name of the Facebook page as shown in the Meta Ad Library. One of page_name or page_id is required.

page_id.description: Numeric id of the Facebook page. Use it instead of page_name when known.

country.description: ISO country code whose ads to collect, e.g. US, FR, IT, or ALL (default ALL).

monitoring.description: Check the page again every week for new ads. Not available on the Lifetime plan.

report_language.description: Language of the report shown in the Pantheon app.

tools.name: run_inspiration_search
tools.description: Collect and analyze the ads of a Facebook page outside the user's niche, to borrow ideas from other markets. Uses 1 Inspiration Search credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result.

page_name.description: Name of the Facebook page as shown in the Meta Ad Library. One of page_name or page_id is required.

page_id.description: Numeric id of the Facebook page. Use it instead of page_name when known.

country.description: ISO country code whose ads to collect, e.g. US, FR, IT, or ALL (default ALL).

report_language.description: Language of the report shown in the Pantheon app.

tools.name: run_brand_campaign_analysis
tools.description: Collect and analyze the ads of the user's own brand Facebook page. Uses 1 Brand Campaigns credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result.

page_name.description: Name of the Facebook page as shown in the Meta Ad Library. One of page_name or page_id is required.

page_id.description: Numeric id of the Facebook page. Use it instead of page_name when known.

country.description: ISO country code whose ads to collect, e.g. US, FR, IT, or ALL (default ALL).

report_language.description: Language of the report shown in the Pantheon app.

tools.name: run_ad_copilot
tools.description: Rewrite an ad from the library into 3 copy variants for the user's audience, offer and brand voice. Uses 1 Ad Copilot credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result.

language.description: Language of the output, e.g. English, Italiano, Français (default Italiano).

tools.name: analyze_ad
tools.description: Run a full AI analysis of one ad: emotional levers, cognitive biases and landing page coherence. Uses 1 Ads Intelligence credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result. Read it later with get_creative_analysis.

ad_id.description: Ad id from search_ads_library, get_competitor_active_ads or get_saved_ads.

language.description: Language of the output, e.g. English, Italiano, Français (default Italiano).

tools.name: run_persuasion_analysis
tools.description: Check a draft ad before launch: which persuasion biases it uses and which are missing, with suggestions. Uses 1 Persuasion Analysis credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result.

ad_type.description: Kind of ad to analyze (default copy).

ad_visual_description.description: Description of the image or video, if there is no media_url.

media_url.description: Public URL of the image or video.

project_id.description: Optional project id from list_projects, to judge the ad against that audience.

landing_page_url.description: Optional URL of the page the ad sends to.

name.description: Name of the analysis in the Pantheon app.

language.description: Language of the output, e.g. English, Italiano, Français (default Italiano).

tools.name: run_sales_psychology
tools.description: Write a sales psychology report that matches a project's customer avatar with an Offer Brief. Uses 1 Sales Psychology credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result.

language.description: Language of the output, e.g. English, Italiano, Français (default Italiano).

tools.name: create_brand_voice
tools.description: Create and save a Brand Voice from a public web page or a text written by the user (about 1 minute). Uses 1 Brand Voice credit.

source_type.description: url to read a public page, text to use the content as is.

content.description: The page URL or the text, depending on source_type.

language.description: Language of the output, e.g. English, Italiano, Français (default Italiano).

tools.name: create_offer_brief
tools.description: Create and save an Offer Brief from a public sales page or a text describing the offer (about 1 minute). Uses 1 Offer Brief credit.

source_type.description: url to read a public sales page, text to use the content as is.

content.description: The sales page URL or the text, depending on source_type.

language.description: Language of the output, e.g. English, Italiano, Français (default Italiano).

tools.name: run_magic_tool
tools.description: Summarize or translate a text, or extract its contacts and links (Magic Tools). Summaries and extractions keep the language of the text; translations go to `language` (default Italiano).

mode.description: What to do with the text.

tools.name: list_followed_creators
tools.description: Viral Content: the creators the user follows (platform, author_key, name, number of collected posts, last post date) and their follow limit.

tools.name: get_followed_creators_contents
tools.description: Viral Content: posts of the creators the user follows, newest first (24 per page). times_author_median is how many times the post beat the author's usual result. Filter by platform and author (author_key from list_followed_creators).

author.description: Only this creator: author_key from list_followed_creators

offset.description: Pagination: number of posts to skip (pages of 24)

tools.name: get_viral_content
tools.description: Viral Content: one post (caption, metrics) with the user's saved analysis in that language, if any, and the vocabulary of persuasion mechanism codes to use in save_viral_analysis.

lang.description: Language of the saved analysis to return

tools.name: save_viral_analysis
tools.description: Viral Content: save your 'why it works' analysis of a post (from get_viral_content) for the user, in one language. It appears in the app on that post, only for this user, and uses no Pantheon credits. Overwrites the user's previous analysis in that language. Base it on the caption and metrics only: do not invent what the video shows.

lang.description: Language the analysis is written in

hook.description: The opening line or promise and why it stops the scroll (max 2 sentences)

structure.description: 3 to 5 short steps describing how the post is built

why_it_works.description: 3 short reasons tied to the audience and the metrics

reuse.description: 3 concrete ways to apply the same pattern to another business

tools.name: send_to_pantheon
tools.description: Send a link to the user's Pantheon. Without a destination Pantheon picks it from the link: a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or LinkedIn profile -> followed in Viral Content > My creators; a post -> its author is followed and the post is saved with its metrics; a Meta Ad Library link -> saved in the Swipe file; any other link -> the Whiteboard inbox (with the optional note). Returns where it went. Max 50 links a day. Use it when the user asks to save, send or keep something in Pantheon.

url.description: https link of a post, profile, ad or page

destination.description: Where to send it; leave empty to let Pantheon choose from the link

note.description: Optional note shown with the link (Whiteboard inbox, Swipe file)

tools.name: list_pantheon_inbox
tools.description: Links the user sent to the Pantheon Whiteboard inbox and has not used yet (newest first).

tools.name: get_market_alerts
tools.description: The user's latest market alerts: new pages in their sectors in the public Ads Library, the week's Top Ads in those sectors and new pages in their radar. Use it when the user asks what is new in their market. Empty when they did not choose to get the alerts in their AI assistant (Settings > Integrations).

limit.description: How many digests, newest first (default 3, max 20)

tools.name: list_radar_offers
tools.description: List the user's offers that have the radar on, with their niche and target countries. Use the ids with get_ideas_matrix and build_ideas_matrix.

tools.name: get_ideas_matrix
tools.description: Get the ideas matrix of an offer: the angles (what an ad claims, to whom) and formats (style + structure) of the niche's ads, and the best angle x format combinations for the offer with why, an example hook, a score and how many niche ads already run it. Null when never built.

tools.name: get_competitor_xray
tools.description: Get the X-ray of a competitor page analyzed with the Competitor Spy: main angles, hooks that last, offer, gaps, style/structure/awareness mix and a swipe file. Null when never run.

tools.name: build_ideas_matrix
tools.description: Build (or rebuild) the ideas matrix of an offer from the ads of its radar. Uses 1 ideas matrix credit and 1 ad label credit per ad not labeled yet. Tell the user the cost and get their OK first. Runs in the background (1-2 minutes): call the matching get_ tool until status is done or failed.

tools.name: run_competitor_xray
tools.description: Run the X-ray of a competitor page analyzed with the Competitor Spy. Uses 1 X-ray credit and 1 ad label credit per ad not labeled yet. Tell the user the cost and get their OK first. Runs in the background (1-2 minutes): call the matching get_ tool until status is done or failed.
